preconditions.description: The polynomial must be a string and x must be an integer.

preconditions.expression: all(c in polynomial for c in 'x^+-0123456789') and not any(c in polynomial for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')
preconditions.description: The polynomial string must only contain valid characters for coefficients, exponents, and operators.

preconditions.expression: all(int(term.split('^')[1]) >= 0 for term in polynomial.split('+') if '^' in term)
preconditions.description: All exponents in the polynomial must be non-negative integers.

postconditions.description: The output must be the result of differentiating the polynomial at the given value of x.
